title: IPC admin.trust.seed result
description: What a seed did (IPC 3.0, ADR-0067 decision 6, LOCAL-IPC.md §The endpoint dimension). `seeded`: the endpoint had no set in the endpoint overlay and now holds a copy of what it admitted. `present`: the overlay already carried a set for the endpoint, an empty one included, and nothing was written. `outcome` is closed at those two values, and there is no third: a refusal is the error `InvalidArgument` (the copy would cross the row bound, audited `refused`, nothing written), `EndpointUnknown` or `Internal`, never an outcome.
